TestCaller - persistent text commands for real audio calls
Shell: TestCaller.exe [options]
Source: dotnet run --no-build -- [options]  (first run dotnet build)
--help / -h shows this help without loading credentials, models, or network connections.
--list-microphones lists device names without opening a call or loading speech models.
NuGet (Windows x64 and macOS arm64): dotnet tool install --global RoyChen.TestCaller
  testcaller --download-models [--models <directory>] [--models-base-url <mirror-url>]
  testcaller [options]
NuGet models survive upgrades: %LOCALAPPDATA%\TestCaller\models on Windows,
~/Library/Application Support/TestCaller/models on macOS. --download-models needs no PowerShell.

Keep this process and stdin open between commands. Send one command per line.
Commands are case-insensitive; redirected stdin works without a TTY.
  dial <destination>   Call an E.164 number, sip:user@host[:port], or demo ws/wss URL.
  connect [ws-url]     Connect to a demo endpoint; omitted URL uses --to / TESTCALLER_TO.
                       Requests binary audio; older servers fall back to JSON.
                       Add binaryAudio=false to the URL query for legacy mode.
  speak <text>         Synthesize and send English speech (1-2000 characters, <=60 seconds).
                       Waits for transmission, not the agent's full reply.
  dtmf <digits>        Send keypad input: 0-9, *, #, A-D (case-insensitive).
  listen [seconds]     Optional wait; default 5 seconds, range >0 to 300.
                       Replies also print while stdin is idle. Returns early if call ends.
  hangup               Cancel dialing or end the current call; process stays running.
  help                 Show this complete setup and command reference.
  quit / exit          Hang up and exit. EOF and Ctrl-C also stop and clean up.
Agent replies print automatically, including while waiting for your next command.
listen only delays the next command; it does not enable audio reception.
Use hangup before another dial/c
